First, convert 31 weeks and 2 days to days:  
31 weeks × 7 days/week = 217 days  
217 + 2 = 219 days to subtract.

Date given: 1017-05-12 (assuming format DD-MM-YYYY means 12 May 1017).  
Subtract 219 days:  
May has 31 days, so from May 12 go back 12 days → April 30, 1017.  
Remaining days: 219 − 12 = 207 days left to subtract.

1017 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but year < 1582, but using Gregorian rules as instructed: 1017 mod 4 = 1, so not leap).  
Go back month by month from April 30, 1017:  
March: 31 days → 207 − 31 = 176 left  
February: 28 days → 176 − 28 = 148 left  
January: 31 days → 148 − 31 = 117 left  
December 1016: 31 days → 117 − 31 = 86 left  
November 1016: 30 days → 86 − 30 = 56 left  
October 1016: 31 days → 56 − 31 = 25 left  
September 1016: 30 days → 25 − 30 = −5 days (means go into August).  

From September 1, 1016, go back 5 days:  
August 31 → 1 day back → Aug 31  
August 30 → 2 days back → Aug 30  
… until 5 days back from Sep 1 = August 27, 1016.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1016-08-27
